messages:
sara: Quick decision needed on "burst packs" for Dedicated GA — two options on the table: (1) discrete add-on bundles customers buy (e.g., 1M tokens/mo), (2) an "elastic" tier that expands commit automatically with usage. which becomes the default GA offering? @matt @ankit @julia
matt: vote: add-on bundles. clearer invoicing and fewer legal surprises. customers know what they bought. :thumbsup:
ankit: add-on + clear telemetry. but we need fast UX for AE checkout and an in-console 'top up' flow. also we should define whether unused packs rollover. my instinct: partial rollover short window (30 days).
julia: legal: if bundles auto-bill on threshold must be explicit opt-in. proposing any auto-charge > $4k/mo require signed amendment. will draft wording if we pick elastic.
omar: infra: elastic tier = much more router complexity (preemption, cross-tenant fairness). add-ons are simpler: quota checks and reject/route without heavy rebalancing. can probably deliver add-on in 1 sprint + 1 sprint for dashboard. elastic is 3+ sprints.
pricing-bot: CONTRACT-AMP-03 template exists for burst allowances; suggests soft cap + negotiated overage rate and 14-day invoice term (internal link: internal/contracts/CONTRACT-AMP-03)
sara: proposed GA acceptance checklist (short): 1) AE pricing sheet + standard burst SKU 2) customer-facing purchase flow in Console 3) quota dashboard with usage and remaining pack count 4) billing events + invoice mapping 5) router fallback when burst exhausted (model variant or degrade) 6) telemetry by customer/model/route 7) regression test suite for latency/cost 
matt: sales ops note: create a mapped bundle that cleanly converts to commit tiers to avoid double-counting bandwidth with committed capacity. e.g., 1M tokens burst pack maps to equivalent vGPU-hours for SOWs.
ankit: telemetry needs: burst_pack_id, customer_id, model_variant, route_id, tokens_consumed, timestamp. will add schema in GH and link.
julia: legal follow-ups: if add-on packs are refundable? suggest non-refundable but transferable across subaccounts with signed request. will propose in clause draft.
omar: infra tasks: router quota hook + fallback path + canary flag (5% customers) + ops runbook for manual throttle. estimate: design (2 d), implementation (6 d), canary rollout (3 d).
sara: decision leaning add-on by consensus. two open design choices: rollover window (ankit proposes 30d), and enterprise uncapped bursts behind PO (matt mentioned). thoughts?
matt: enterprise uncapped behind a PO is fine but must have a clear playbook: pre-authorization, committed buffer, and ops contact. include it as an enterprise-only add-on SKU with SLAs.
ankit: +1 on 30d rollover. makes sales easier and reduces churn complaints. also add usage alerts at 50/80/95% of pack.
julia: legal: approve 30d rollover but add a clause that rollover cannot exceed 2x monthly pack size to avoid credit hoarding. I'll draft.
sara: action items:
- @julia: draft contract language + refund/transfer rules (EOD Wed)
- @ankit: telemetry schema + alert thresholds + TTL default 30d (PR in GH)
- @omar: infra PRD + router implementation estimate + ops runbook
- @matt: AE pricing sheet + enterprise uncapped SKU mapping to SOW
- @hana-salesops: update pricing catalog and billing mappings once AE sheet ready
I'll mark this as a dependency for Dedicated GA. GA may slip one sprint if infra estimate holds. reconvene after PRDs and drafts land. :calendar:
